swift: Apple Swift 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1), macOS 27.0 SDK, deployment macOS 26
primary: recipe preparation through completed atomic write
sampling: 5 fresh-process baseline/candidate pairs; alternate order; 2 warmups and 9 measured iterations per workload per process
decision: Retain if the primary bounded PNG workload has >=10% median completed-time improvement, every other workload has no >10% aggregate slowdown, PNG/JPEG files are byte-identical with matching dimensions and metadata, and peak RSS increase is <=10% + 2 MiB. limits: No personal files, general clipboard changes, shared/third-party load tests, quality reduction, polling or debounce changes. No timings under build contention.
tooling: Explicit installed Xcode compiler, SDK and SwiftUI macro plugin, with CLT used for Git discovery. No system toolchain or license settings changed.
